attributes.title: Psych Congress Elevate 2027
attributes.credits_text: 16.75 AMA PRA Cat 1 · 16.75 ANCC CH · 16.75 ACPE
attributes.summary:
Psych Congress Elevate 2027 runs June 3 to 6, 2027, at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas. It is aimed at early-career mental health clinicians: psychiatrists, nurse practitioners, PAs, psychologists and primary care physicians.

HMP Education designates the live activity for 16.75 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits, with matching nursing and pharmacy contact hours; the enduring version with recorded content is designated for 31.75. Registration is open and the early bird rate runs until February 19, 2027. The Caesars Palace group rate is $189 a night Tuesday to Friday and $219 on weekend nights, plus a $45 daily resort fee, if booked before April 26. Registration fees were not shown on the rates page when we checked.
